title: E2R LiaisonScape Presentation Extension Draft 0.1.0
description: Structural validation schema for the value of the draft.github.sukoyaka-dopeness.liaisonscape-presentation Extension at exact version 0.1.0.
$comment: This schema validates the Extension payload only. Relation-ID resolution, canonical omission of defaults and empty records, orphan handling, and unknown-token interpretation remain separate responsibilities. The normative requirements remain in extensions/presentation-extension-draft.md.

arrowDisplay.description: Known values are normal, reverse, undirected, and bidirectional. Other strings are structurally preserved as unsupported future values and receive the reader's Normal fallback.

lineStyle.description: Known values are solid, dashed, and dotted. Other strings are structurally preserved as unsupported future values and receive the reader's Solid fallback.
